numerical_admission: CPU feature and gradient exact; GPU feature exact, FP32 gradients torch.assert_close rtol1e-5 atol1e-6 AND max drift<=max(2*original-self-replay,1e-6). Set before any cohort training; native cuDNN backward replay is not assumed bitwise deterministic. Actual real-FIT forward parity exact and all gradient paths finite/nonzero after zero-head burn-in.
A1: Reuse exact matched previously trained DELTA14 no-patient-Z CompactDelta1537 FIT-only base and preprocessing; train fresh M8 correction. Raw96 patient Z, physiology gate and pre-onset latent reference unchanged. Not the earlier both-PR-removed model.
A2: Original frozen D1 with feature PR. Remove only final full-patient Z on raw-summary96; retain pre-reference, physiology gate and all per-window standardization.
A3: Original frozen D1 with feature PR, raw96 PR and pre-reference retained. Replace physiology gate by parameter-free all-ones24 identity. Retain constructor RNG consumption before removal so CNN/head initialization matches original. No seven-dimensional physiology enters prediction via the identity branch; D1 physiology branch remains.
A4: Original frozen D1 with feature PR, raw96 PR and gate retained. Set raw latent=embedding instead of embedding minus same-channel pre-onset mean. Keep existing masks, all windows, post-onset stage pooling and original7D physiology DELTA definition; do not remove its reference or window-wise normalization.
A6: Independent existing frozen D1 PR and independently trained standalone M8 Raw-only (8433 params, bounded tanh NEZ logit) models. No encoder refit. Convex probability fusion pNEZ=(1-w)*pD1+w*pRaw; w0:0.05:1. Own-fold validation chooses jointly w and original NEZ threshold by patient MacroF1, EZF1, then lower raw weight. Each threshold chosen by unchanged original core rule. No logit fusion or test-selected weights.
initialization: 42+1009*fold; reproduce exact original M8 fresh initializer and frozen own-fold base. Correction CNN/head/gate are scratch, no trained raw/M8 initializer; frozen base checkpoint reused. A1 differs only frozen noPR base and its necessary FIT preprocessing; other correction initials matched.

training.updates: one channel-mean update per FIT patient
training.loss: original M8 0.75 FIT-only NEZ-class-weighted BCE(final)+0.25 patient soft Macro-F1
training.selection: original validation patient Macro-F1, EZ-F1, earlier epoch; original NEZ threshold grid/ties
training.precision: FP32, TF32 off, cuDNN retained, original chunk4096

outer: Freeze20 new selected checkpoints,5 fusion weights/thresholds and15 historical reference selections BEFORE new Outer inference; seal40 arm-fold score files before reading full evaluation labels. Hash-verified patient-level private caches allow engineering resume only. No model/threshold tuning after Outer.

bootstrap.interval: percentile95, fixed models/weights/thresholds, unadjusted for multiplicity

metrics: Patient-macro primary, separate pooled/fold/center/coverage/confusion/ranking; include AUROC, AP, MacroF1, EZ-F1, NEZ-F1, accuracy, signed EZ fraction bias, MRR, Top1. Undefined metrics remain unavailable, not favorable zeros.
privacy: Only source,hashes and anonymous aggregates leave server. No raw EEG, patient/channel identities, labels, individual predictions, checkpoint/scaler/cache or logs. Preserve historical artifacts and unrelated jobs; no installed research/extraction skills.
